Package org.osgi.test.cases.zigbee.config.file

Class ConfigurationFileReader

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.test.cases.zigbee.config.file.ConfigurationFileReader
public class ConfigurationFileReader extends Object
This class is used to parse the TCK configuration file. Currently it has been designed to be compatible with older JRE, but in the future this class could be really simplified by using JAXB.

      public int getHeaderMinSize()
      Return the minimum ZCL Header Size, that is the ZCL Header size when the ZCLFrame is not manufacturer specific. This information is avaiable in the ZCL specification and must be written in the TCK configuration file.
